title: Pavlivka
summary: Pavlivka refers to multiple settlements located [[coal-in-ukraine|in Ukraine]], each with distinct administrative affiliations across various regions.

sections.heading: Pavlivka in Donetsk Oblast
paragraphs: One of the settlements named Pavlivka is a village situated in the [[vuhledar|Vuhledar]] urban hromada within the Volnovakha Raion of [[donetsk-oblast|Donetsk Oblast]].

sections.heading: Pavlivka in Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast
paragraphs: Another Pavlivka is a village located in the Yamnytsia rural hromada of [[ivano-frankivsk-raion|Ivano-Frankivsk Raion]] in [[ivano-frankivsk-oblast|Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast]].

sections.heading: Pavlivka in Luhansk Oblast
paragraphs: In [[luhansk-oblast|Luhansk Oblast]], Pavlivka is identified as a rural settlement within the Dovzhansk urban hromada of Dovzhansk Raion.

sections.heading: Pavlivka in Odesa Oblast
paragraphs: There is also a village named Pavlivka in the Stepanivka rural hromada, which is part of the Rozdilna Raion in [[odesa-oblast|Odesa Oblast]].

sections.heading: Pavlivka in Vinnytsia Oblast
paragraphs: Additionally, a village called Pavlivka exists in the Kalynivka urban hromada of Khmilnyk Raion in [[vinnytsia-oblast|Vinnytsia Oblast]].

sections.heading: Administrative Centre in Volyn Oblast
paragraphs: Pavlivka also serves as the administrative centre of the Pavlivka rural hromada in Volodymyr Raion, located in [[volyn-oblast|Volyn Oblast]].
